zh-CN.title: 修复官方账号 Rive 人物加载
items: 官方账号进入广场时使用独立舞台，不再加载在线用户和旧人物系统
修正画板与状态机绑定，人物现在可以持续播放原地行走动画
支持即时切换五套人物皮肤，并为每个官方账号记住当前选择
旧会话会先确认官方身份，不再错误进入普通广场

en.title: Fixed Rive character loading for official accounts
items: Official accounts now enter a dedicated stage without loading online users or the legacy character system
Correct artboard and state machine bindings now play the walking-in-place animation continuously
Five character skins can be switched instantly and remembered per official account
Legacy sessions now resolve official identity before choosing the square experience
